# appsignal_log_source (Resource)

A log source in an AppSignal app: an endpoint that accepts log lines with its own key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_log_source" "vector" {
  app_id         = appsignal_app.web.id
  name           = "vector"
  type           = "http_json"
  format         = "json"
  parse_severity = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Kind of source, for example `http_json`. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `format` (String) How lines are parsed: plaintext, logfmt, json, autodetect. Defaults to `plaintext`.
- `parse_severity` (Boolean) Read the severity from the line. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Ingestion key of this source.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_log_source.vector <app_id>/<log_source_id>
```
